libs.note: BH-5942. The entry of the three LLM alert lanes (alert-triage, alerts-medic, watchdog-responder) on the per-project runner (bin/lib/project-lanes.sh). The cron line, with no argument, dispatches one detached run per fleet.conf project; each run holds only locks/<lane>-<project>.lock, reads only its project's items, and runs its claude call on the project's pinned account (ACCOUNT_PROJECT_FOR_LANE) with the project's GitHub App token. Applied by the lib itself with lib_env_apply llm-lane-project.

knobs.note: Each project run of an LLM alert lane starts at a stable offset inside this window (a hash of lane and project, never within 5 s of a whole minute). 300 keeps every start inside the shortest cadence (alert-triage, 10 minutes). 0 starts every project run at once. A non-number falls back to 300 with one log line.
The project whose run owns an alert with no project, the project `harness`, or a project that is not in fleet.conf. A value that is not a plain name falls back to cromford.
